content: I don't seem to be able to get the cache for a batteries testing branch which builds (but for which linting fails). (Specifically, batteries-pr-testing-1831.) Is that expected?
Hmm, it seems like the upload to cache CI step succeeded, but I don't get any files when running lake exe cache get. Can anyone reproduce?

The cache for the PR toolchain tests in nightly-testing is not fetched from (intentionally, as it's trivial to poison artifacts with a lean4 PR in this way) and you need to call it with the explicit option lake exe cache get --cache-from=pr-toolchain-tests if you trust that branch
We may want to surface that info in the logs and / or add it somewhere on this page: https://leanprover-community.github.io/contribute/tags_and_branches.html
